about: Longueuil is on the South Shore of the St. Lawrence, directly across from Montréal. It is a major suburb linked to the island by bridge, Métro, and the REM. The city includes the former towns of Greenfield Park and Saint-Hubert and the historic Vieux-Longueuil riverside. About 250,000 people live in Longueuil.
seoSummary: Montréal’s South Shore hub, with a historic riverfront and Métro links to the island.
